title: Casdatifan shows durable response linked to HIF-2α biology in kidney cancer.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Read the data availability statement and searched the full open-access text (PMC13489952) for source data and individual-level tables. Found no public patient-level files. The only deposited accession is EGAS00001004353 on EGA (European Genome-phenome Archive), a controlled-access archive. The Europe PMC supplementary-file listing timed out after 75 s and was not retried.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Cohort sizes (127 patients in total, 32 at 100 mg once daily), response rates, and the statement that individual participant data 'may be available on request' from Arcus Biosciences, only for qualified researchers and only after regulatory approval. Patient-level data from the external IMmotion151 trial sits on EGA under a Genentech agreement. JAVELIN Renal 101 expression data is described as public (reference 41), but it comes from a different trial and a different drug.

a1_downloadable.note: Checked the paper text only. Trial patient data is 'available on request' from the sponsor, Arcus Biosciences, and only after drug approval. The IMmotion151 expression data is controlled access on EGA (EGAS00001004353). Code is also withheld.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: Not checked, because no files are available. The obvious labels (objective response, PFS (progression-free survival)) would exist in sponsor tables, but nothing public was found.

a3_inputs_present.note: No public inputs. Serum erythropoietin time courses, HIF-2α staining and RNA expression for ARC-20 patients are not deposited.

a4_units_stated.note: Not assessable, because there are no files.

a5_enough_rows.note: Taken from the paper only: 127 patients in the dose-expansion cohort, and fewer with biopsy RNA data. Far below the 400-row minimum even for classification.

a6_fits_laptop.note: If the data were obtainable, a table of about 127 patients would fit easily.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: Can't be verified, because there are no files.

a8_label_provenance.note: Clinical response is a measured outcome: RECIST (standard tumour-size response criteria), confirmed by the investigator. It is not a model output.

honest_claim_h3: No claim is possible. Patient-level data from the trial is not public, and the cohort of 127 patients is too small for machine learning.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use tumour gene expression and early blood erythropoietin drop to predict which kidney cancer patients respond to a HIF-2α-blocking drug.
plain_idea.train_on: Per-patient tumour RNA expression, HIF-2α protein staining and the serum erythropoietin time course from the ARC-20 trial. That is about 127 patients by the paper's count, and none of it is public.
plain_idea.predict: Confirmed objective tumour response or progression-free survival, as measured by investigators using RECIST (standard tumour-size criteria) on imaging.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Oncologists could pick patients for HIF-2α inhibitors. But with 127 patients and data released only on request, it can't be done here.

ml_idea: A predictor of response to HIF-2α inhibitors from tumour expression signatures and erythropoietin pharmacodynamics (how far blood erythropoietin falls on treatment). It is blocked by sponsor-held data and a cohort of only 127 patients.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated, because no data is accessible.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Read the data availability statement. It already kills the project: the data is on request from the sponsor, and the partner data is controlled access on EGA.

verdict_reason: Fails A1 and A5. Patient-level trial data is only 'available on request' from Arcus Biosciences after drug approval. The partner IMmotion151 data is controlled access on EGA (EGAS00001004353), the code is withheld, and the cohort is only 127 patients. We did not search for existing models because Part A failed.
